title: Jello's Minigames
description: A fully customizable minigame plugin with king of the hill, boss events, and destory the core - works with teams or solo players
body:
# JelloMinigames

**Three minigames in one lightweight plugin — set it up in minutes.**

JelloMinigames brings **King of the Hill**, **Destroy the Core**, and fully custom **Boss Events** to your server. Everything is edited from clean in-game menus and runs on a schedule you control.

---

## 🎮 The minigames

### 👑 King of the Hill
Stand in the zone to capture it. Hold it long enough and you (or your team) win. Turn on capture **decay** to keep fights tense when the hill empties out.

### 💥 Destroy the Core
Race to break a block — whoever lands the **final hit** takes the prize. You choose the block, how many hits it takes, and an optional time limit.

### 🐲 Boss Events
Spawn a fully custom boss: pick the **mob, health, speed, armor, weapon, and damage**, then toggle abilities like poison auras, knockback, lightning, shield-disable, and fire resistance. Whoever deals the most damage wins — and everyone sees a **"boss slain"** top-damage leaderboard.

---

## ✨ Features

- **Edit everything in-game** — arenas, rewards, and settings through simple GUI menus or commands. No YAML wrestling.
- **Flexible rewards** — items, money, console commands, and chance-based drops. Reward the winner, the top players, or everyone who joined in.
- **Solo or team play** — plays nicely with your favorite teams plugin.
- **Automatic scheduling** — run events manually, on a timer, at set clock times, or as a random rotation.
- **Boss bars with coordinates** — players always know where to go.
- **Leaderboards & stats** to show off your best players.
- **MiniMessage formatting** for gradients and modern text.

---

## 🔌 Works with

PlaceholderAPI · Vault / economy plugins · AdvancedTeams · UltimateTeams · BetterTeams · EssentialsX

## ✅ Requirements

- **Paper 1.21+**
- **Java 21**

---

## 🚀 Getting started

1. Drop the jar into your `plugins` folder and restart.
2. Run `/koth gui`, `/dtc gui`, or `/boss gui` to create and edit your events.
3. Set rewards, pick a schedule, and let it run. That's it!
